---
title: "UAM Capacity · Risco vs Capacidade"
subtitle: "Interlagos — sw vs nsw — sweep K × C × routing × policy"
format:
  html:
    theme: darkly
    page-layout: full
    self-contained: true
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        <script>
        /* Inicializa ANTES do corpo para que os <script> de metadados
           possam preencher os objetos sem erros de undefined. */
        window.riskMeta  = {};
        window.riskState = {};
        </script>
    include-after-body:
      text: |
        <script>
        /* Generic filter: each chart stores its own state under uid.
           dim2 can be 'k' (filter by K, x=C) or 'c' (filter by C, x=K). */
        function riskFilter(uid, dim, val) {
          var s = window.riskState[uid];
          if (!s) return;
          if (dim === 'sc') s.sc = val;
          else if (dim === 'k') s.k = parseInt(val);
          else if (dim === 'c') s.c = parseInt(val);

          var meta = window.riskMeta[uid];
          var vis     = [];
          var showleg = [];
          var seen    = {};
          meta.forEach(function(m) {
            var sc_ok  = (m.sc === s.sc);
            var dim_ok = (s.dim2 === 'k') ? (m.k === s.k) : (m.c === s.c);
            var active = sc_ok && dim_ok;
            var first  = active && !seen[m.pol];
            if (first) seen[m.pol] = true;
            vis.push(active ? true : false);
            showleg.push(first);
          });

          var ctr  = document.getElementById('risk-ctr-' + uid);
          var pdiv = ctr ? ctr.querySelector('.js-plotly-plot') : null;
          if (pdiv && pdiv._fullLayout) {
            Plotly.restyle(pdiv, { visible: vis, showlegend: showleg });
          }

          if (ctr) {
            ctr.querySelectorAll('[data-sc]').forEach(function(b) {
              _btnOn(b, b.dataset.sc === s.sc, '#378ADD');
            });
            ctr.querySelectorAll('[data-k]').forEach(function(b) {
              _btnOn(b, parseInt(b.dataset.k) === s.k, '#F4A261');
            });
            ctr.querySelectorAll('[data-c]').forEach(function(b) {
              _btnOn(b, parseInt(b.dataset.c) === s.c, '#F4A261');
            });
          }
        }

        function _btnOn(b, on, accent) {
          b.style.background  = on ? accent    : '#1a1a2e';
          b.style.color       = on ? '#ffffff' : '#a6adc8';
          b.style.borderColor = on ? accent    : '#3a3a5a';
        }

        /* Resize plotly ao mostrar tab (resolve render em display:none) */
        document.addEventListener('shown.bs.tab', function(e) {
          var sel = e.target.getAttribute('data-bs-target')
                 || ('#' + e.target.getAttribute('aria-controls'));
          var pane = sel ? document.querySelector(sel) : null;
          if (!pane) return;
          pane.querySelectorAll('.js-plotly-plot').forEach(function(d) {
            if (d._fullLayout) Plotly.Plots.resize(d);
          });
        });
        </script>
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)
library(htmltools)
library(jsonlite)

df_all <- read.csv("data/capacity_summary.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Apenas experimento sw vs nsw assimétrico
df <- df_all[df_all$experiment == "capacity_15min_sw_nsw_assimetrico", ]

POL_COLORS <- c(
  "round-robin"      = "#4DA6FF",
  "round-robin-sw"   = "#99CCFF",
  "pf-classic"       = "#FF5252",
  "pf-classic-sw"    = "#FF9999",
  "max-weight-drift" = "#33CC66",
  "max-weight-sw"    = "#99FFCC",
  "aoi-normalized"   = "#FF9900"
)
POL_DASH <- c(
  "round-robin"      = "solid",
  "round-robin-sw"   = "dash",
  "pf-classic"       = "solid",
  "pf-classic-sw"    = "dash",
  "max-weight-drift" = "solid",
  "max-weight-sw"    = "dash",
  "aoi-normalized"   = "dot"
)

BG    <- "#1e1e2e"; PANEL <- "#13131f"
TEXT  <- "#cdd6f4"; AXIS  <- "#a6adc8"; GRID  <- "#2a2a4a"
C_TICKS <- sort(unique(df$C))
K_TICKS <- sort(unique(df$K))

# ── Helpers HTML ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
.btn <- function(label, active, accent, onclick_str, ...) {
  bg  <- if (active) accent    else "#1a1a2e"
  col <- if (active) "#ffffff" else "#a6adc8"
  brd <- if (active) accent    else "#3a3a5a"
  tags$button(label, ...,
    onclick = onclick_str,
    style   = paste0(
      "background:", bg, ";color:", col, ";border:1px solid ", brd, ";",
      "border-radius:5px;padding:4px 12px;font-size:11px;",
      "cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s;white-space:nowrap;"
    )
  )
}
.lbl <- function(txt) tags$span(txt, style = paste0(
  "color:#6a6a8a;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.08em;",
  "text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap;align-self:center;"
))
.sep <- function() tags$div(style =
  "width:1px;background:#2a2a4a;align-self:stretch;margin:0 4px;"
)

# ── Gráfico: eixo X = C, filtro por K ────────────────────────────────────────
build_risk_chart <- function(d, uid, yvar = "mean_risk", ylabel = "Risco médio total",
                             hover_label = "Risco") {
  pols_exp <- intersect(names(POL_COLORS), unique(d$policy))

  df_sc <- d |>
    group_by(scenario, K, C, policy) |>
    summarise(yval = mean(.data[[yvar]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  df_avg <- df_sc |>
    group_by(K, C, policy) |>
    summarise(yval = mean(yval, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(scenario = "Todos")

  df_plot   <- bind_rows(df_sc, df_avg)
  scenarios <- c("Todos", sort(unique(df_sc$scenario)))
  k_vals    <- sort(unique(d$K))
  default_k <- k_vals[1]

  fig        <- plot_ly()
  trace_meta <- vector("list", 0)
  seen_pols  <- character(0)

  for (sc in scenarios) {
    for (k in k_vals) {
      for (pol in pols_exp) {
        sub <- filter(df_plot, scenario == sc, K == k, policy == pol)
        if (nrow(sub) == 0) next

        is_def    <- sc == "Todos" && k == default_k
        first_leg <- !pol %in% seen_pols
        if (first_leg) seen_pols <- c(seen_pols, pol)

        trace_meta[[length(trace_meta) + 1]] <-
          list(sc = sc, k = as.integer(k), pol = pol, leg = first_leg)

        fig <- add_trace(fig,
          data          = sub, x = ~C, y = ~yval,
          type          = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
          name          = pol,
          showlegend    = first_leg,
          visible       = is_def,
          line          = list(color = POL_COLORS[pol], width = 2.5,
                               dash  = POL_DASH[pol]),
          marker        = list(color = POL_COLORS[pol], size  = 6),
          hovertemplate = paste0(
            "<b>", pol, "</b><br>C = %{x}<br>", hover_label,
            " = %{y:.4g}<extra></extra>"
          )
        )
      }
    }
  }

  fig <- layout(fig,
    xaxis  = list(title = "Capacidade C (drones simultâneos)",
                  color = AXIS, gridcolor = GRID,
                  tickvals = C_TICKS, zeroline = FALSE),
    yaxis  = list(title = ylabel,
                  color = AXIS, gridcolor = GRID, zeroline = FALSE),
    plot_bgcolor  = PANEL, paper_bgcolor = BG,
    font          = list(color = TEXT, size = 11),
    legend        = list(font    = list(color = TEXT, size = 10),
                         bgcolor = BG,
                         title   = list(text = "Política",
                                        font = list(color = AXIS, size = 10))),
    margin    = list(l = 70, r = 20, t = 16, b = 55),
    hovermode = "x unified"
  ) |> config(displayModeBar = FALSE)

  sc_btns <- lapply(scenarios, function(sc) {
    lbl <- if (sc == "Todos") "Todos (média)" else sc
    .btn(lbl, sc == "Todos", "#378ADD",
         sprintf("riskFilter('%s','sc','%s')", uid, sc),
         `data-sc` = sc)
  })
  k_btns <- lapply(k_vals, function(k) {
    .btn(paste0("K = ", k), k == default_k, "#F4A261",
         sprintf("riskFilter('%s','k',%d)", uid, as.integer(k)),
         `data-k` = k)
  })

  filter_bar <- tags$div(
    style = paste0("display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 14px;",
                   "padding:10px 16px;margin-bottom:10px;",
                   "background:#0d0d18;border-radius:7px;align-items:center;"),
    .lbl("Cenário"),
    tags$div(style = "display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;", sc_btns),
    .sep(),
    .lbl("K slots/época"),
    tags$div(style = "display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;", k_btns)
  )

  meta_script <- tags$script(HTML(sprintf(
    "window.riskMeta['%s']  = %s;\nwindow.riskState['%s'] = {sc:'Todos', k:%d, dim2:'k'};",
    uid, toJSON(trace_meta, auto_unbox = TRUE),
    uid, as.integer(default_k)
  )))

  tags$div(
    id    = paste0("risk-ctr-", uid),
    style = "padding:6px 0 0;",
    filter_bar,
    meta_script,
    fig
  )
}

# ── Gráfico: eixo X = K, filtro por C ────────────────────────────────────────
build_risk_chart_k <- function(d, uid, yvar = "mean_risk", ylabel = "Risco médio total",
                               hover_label = "Risco") {
  pols_exp <- intersect(names(POL_COLORS), unique(d$policy))

  df_sc <- d |>
    group_by(scenario, K, C, policy) |>
    summarise(yval = mean(.data[[yvar]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  df_avg <- df_sc |>
    group_by(K, C, policy) |>
    summarise(yval = mean(yval, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(scenario = "Todos")

  df_plot   <- bind_rows(df_sc, df_avg)
  scenarios <- c("Todos", sort(unique(df_sc$scenario)))
  c_vals    <- sort(unique(d$C))
  default_c <- c_vals[1]

  fig        <- plot_ly()
  trace_meta <- vector("list", 0)
  seen_pols  <- character(0)

  for (sc in scenarios) {
    for (cv in c_vals) {
      for (pol in pols_exp) {
        sub <- filter(df_plot, scenario == sc, C == cv, policy == pol)
        if (nrow(sub) == 0) next

        is_def    <- sc == "Todos" && cv == default_c
        first_leg <- !pol %in% seen_pols
        if (first_leg) seen_pols <- c(seen_pols, pol)

        trace_meta[[length(trace_meta) + 1]] <-
          list(sc = sc, c = as.integer(cv), pol = pol, leg = first_leg)

        fig <- add_trace(fig,
          data          = sub, x = ~K, y = ~yval,
          type          = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
          name          = pol,
          showlegend    = first_leg,
          visible       = is_def,
          line          = list(color = POL_COLORS[pol], width = 2.5,
                               dash  = POL_DASH[pol]),
          marker        = list(color = POL_COLORS[pol], size  = 6),
          hovertemplate = paste0(
            "<b>", pol, "</b><br>K = %{x}<br>", hover_label,
            " = %{y:.4g}<extra></extra>"
          )
        )
      }
    }
  }

  fig <- layout(fig,
    xaxis  = list(title = "K (slots por época)",
                  color = AXIS, gridcolor = GRID,
                  tickvals = K_TICKS, zeroline = FALSE),
    yaxis  = list(title = ylabel,
                  color = AXIS, gridcolor = GRID, zeroline = FALSE),
    plot_bgcolor  = PANEL, paper_bgcolor = BG,
    font          = list(color = TEXT, size = 11),
    legend        = list(font    = list(color = TEXT, size = 10),
                         bgcolor = BG,
                         title   = list(text = "Política",
                                        font = list(color = AXIS, size = 10))),
    margin    = list(l = 70, r = 20, t = 16, b = 55),
    hovermode = "x unified"
  ) |> config(displayModeBar = FALSE)

  sc_btns <- lapply(scenarios, function(sc) {
    lbl <- if (sc == "Todos") "Todos (média)" else sc
    .btn(lbl, sc == "Todos", "#378ADD",
         sprintf("riskFilter('%s','sc','%s')", uid, sc),
         `data-sc` = sc)
  })
  c_btns <- lapply(c_vals, function(cv) {
    .btn(paste0("C = ", cv), cv == default_c, "#F4A261",
         sprintf("riskFilter('%s','c',%d)", uid, as.integer(cv)),
         `data-c` = cv)
  })

  filter_bar <- tags$div(
    style = paste0("display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 14px;",
                   "padding:10px 16px;margin-bottom:10px;",
                   "background:#0d0d18;border-radius:7px;align-items:center;"),
    .lbl("Cenário"),
    tags$div(style = "display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;", sc_btns),
    .sep(),
    .lbl("C drones"),
    tags$div(style = "display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;", c_btns)
  )

  meta_script <- tags$script(HTML(sprintf(
    "window.riskMeta['%s']  = %s;\nwindow.riskState['%s'] = {sc:'Todos', c:%d, dim2:'c'};",
    uid, toJSON(trace_meta, auto_unbox = TRUE),
    uid, as.integer(default_c)
  )))

  tags$div(
    id    = paste0("risk-ctr-", uid),
    style = "padding:6px 0 0;",
    filter_bar,
    meta_script,
    fig
  )
}
```

> **`r nrow(df)` runs** · políticas: `r paste(sort(unique(df$policy)), collapse=" · ")` · K ∈ {`r paste(sort(unique(df$K)), collapse=", ")`} · C `r min(df$C)`–`r max(df$C)`

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Risco × C

```{r chart_c}
build_risk_chart(df, "sw_nsw_c")
```

## Risco × K

```{r chart_k}
build_risk_chart_k(df, "sw_nsw_k")
```

## Peak Risco × C

```{r chart_peak_c}
build_risk_chart(df, "peak_c",
  yvar        = "peak_risk",
  ylabel      = "Risco do pior drone (peak)",
  hover_label = "Peak risco")
```

## Peak Risco × K

```{r chart_peak_k}
build_risk_chart_k(df, "peak_k",
  yvar        = "peak_risk",
  ylabel      = "Risco do pior drone (peak)",
  hover_label = "Peak risco")
```
